history.text: According to ANN Benchmarks (ann-benchmarks.com), FAISS with HNSW indexing achieves a recall@10 of 0.994 at approximately 8,000 queries per second on a single CPU core for 768-dimensional vectors. The flat IndexIVFFlat variant trades some recall (0.973) for higher throughput (~15,000 QPS) with nprobe=16. For GPU-accelerated use cases, FAISS GpuIndexIVFFlat delivers over 1 million QPS on a single A100, making it suitable for large-scale production retrieval at billion-vector scale.
